changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r1100.1: Other plugins can price items and start runs of their own lists through the new Buying API, once you allow them on the Shop page
changelog.r1100.2: Their runs keep your worlds, gil reserve and purchase checks, and History names the plugin that started a run
changelog.r1100.3: Settings, General lists the plugins you answered, with Revoke and Allow; Revoke also stops a run the plugin has under way
changelog.r1101.1: Fixed every market search being refused as mismatched, which left runs standing at the board and buying nothing
changelog.r1101.2: When a search copy is refused, the Console names the listing field that differed
changelog.r1102.1: The market board windows are closed when a run ends on its own, so the character is free to move at once, also for a plugin that started the run
changelog.r1200.1: Dry run is gone: Start always buys for real, up to your run spend cap, so check the cap before your next run
changelog.r1200.2: History drops the rows of past dry runs, which bought nothing
changelog.r1200.3: For plugins: the Buying API's AutoShopper.Api.DryRun call and the dryRun field of RunStatus are removed
changelog.r1300.1: Imports MakePlace and ReMakePlace house layouts: every furnishing, fixture, wallpaper and dye in the house becomes a line, and the import panel can open a file
changelog.r1300.2: Buys from NPC vendors when they cost no more than the market board, housing merchants in the residential districts included, before any market stop
changelog.r1300.3: The Shop page has a How to buy section: buy from everything, the market board only or NPC vendors only, and pick the route mode with buttons
changelog.r1300.4: List lines stay readable in a narrow window: the item name moves above the controls instead of being cut off
changelog.r1310.1: Fixed long sessions ending in a crash or a Start button that stops working; moving around no longer sets up new game hooks each time
changelog.r1001.1: Fixed the aethernet ride to a market board giving up at the shard while the zone was still loading
changelog.r1001.2: Fixed the walk to a market board ending a few metres out of reach, as at Ul'dah's Sapphire Avenue Exchange
changelog.r1000.1: Shopping lists: Any, HQ or NQ, buy an amount or top up to a target, with a max price per unit including the 5% fee
changelog.r1000.2: Imports text, CSV, JSON, Artisan and Teamcraft lists with recipe expansion, plus a crystal top-up helper and exports
changelog.r1000.3: Universalis prices across the worlds you allow in your region; Japanese data centers other than yours stay off by default
changelog.r1000.4: Three plan modes (Cheapest, Balanced, Fewest stops) from whole listings, with the route, estimated totals and any units it cannot cover
changelog.r1000.5: Travels between worlds and data centers with Lifestream, carries on after a data center transfer, and walks to a market board
changelog.r1000.6: Reads the live listings at every stop and plans again from what the board really shows
changelog.r1000.7: Checks every purchase against your caps, gil reserve and bag space, one at a time, and never buys from your own retainers, mannequins or sets
changelog.r1000.8: Writes each purchase to a journal before sending it, confirms it by the server's answer and your gil and bags, and asks you when unsure
changelog.r1000.9: Pause, resume and stop, a way home and an after-run action, and History with copyable summaries free of names and ids
about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.

about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. Zone, item and world names always follow the game client.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
settings.general.dragAnywhereHelp: Move the window by dragging anywhere inside it. When off, only the top bar moves it.
settings.general.autoPauseHelp: Pause the run while you are inside a duty, trial, raid, or any other instanced content, then resume it once you are back outside. Your run and session stats are kept.
settings.general.pauseTypingHelp: While a text box of the game has focus, like the chat line, a run starts no new move until you close it. A move already under way carries on.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto Shopper window. /ashop config | stats | deps | log | changelog | about | add <item name or id> [quantity] (add an item to the selected list) | pause (pause or resume the run) | target (dump the current target's BaseId) | look <item name or id> (log the listings at the market board in reach) | mbstatus (market board checks) | board [city] (go to a market board and open it, board stop cancels) | start (start a run of the selected list) | stop (stop the run) | goto <territory> <x> <y> <z>, goto <world> [aetheryte] [i<n>] or goto home (travel helpers, goto stop cancels).
plugin.configReset: Your settings could not be read, so Auto Shopper started with default settings. The old file is kept as {0}.
plugin.configResetUnsaved: Your settings could not be read, so Auto Shopper started with default settings. The old file could not be kept; the log has the details.
session.autoResumeHelp: If a run hits an unexpected error and stops, restart it automatically (up to 3 times in 5 minutes) instead of ending it. Turn it off if you would rather have errors end the run.
safety.tabSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the run, ping you, or take more drastic action.
safety.gm.stopRunHelp: End the run at once when a GM appears nearby. It is recorded as stopped, and nothing runs after it: no way home and no after-run action. Strongly recommended; the other alerts are little use if the run keeps going.
safety.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"
safety.gm.chatHelp: Print a red chat warning into your local log.
safety.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.
safety.gm.beepCountHelp: How many beeps to play in the burst.
safety.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
safety.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.
humanizer.tabSub: Short random pauses before the run acts, the way a player reacts.
humanizer.enabledHelp: Wait a random moment before each action below, drawn anew each time between the shortest and the longest value. A shortest value above the longest is used as a fixed wait. Off acts at once.
humanizer.moveOffHelp: Before the run sets off toward its next stop, ahead of any teleport or move.
humanizer.teleportHelp: Before each teleport the run casts.
lists.title: Lists

lists.emptyList: This list is empty. Search above to add an item, or import a list.
lists.addHint: Add an item: type its name or item id
lists.loadFailed: Item data could not be loaded. The console has the details.
lists.listFull: A list holds at most {0} lines.
lists.sortHint: Click to sort. Sorting changes only this view, never the list.
lists.qualityHelp: Any takes HQ or NQ. HQ and NQ take only that quality.
lists.noHighQuality: This item has no HQ version.
lists.mode.buyHelp: Buy the quantity during the run, whatever you already own.
lists.mode.reachHelp: Buy only what is missing for you to own the quantity.
lists.capHelp: The most this line may pay for one unit, including the 5% market fee. Leave it empty for no cap of its own; the run's spending limit still applies.
lists.excessHelp: How many units over the quantity the run may buy when only bigger stacks are listed. 0 never buys more than asked.
lists.ownedHelp: Counted in your bags, crystals, armory chest and equipped gear. Saddlebags and retainers are not counted.
lists.ownedUnknown: Log in to see what you own.
lists.inventoryNote: Owned counts cover your bags, crystals, armory chest and equipped gear. Saddlebags and retainers are not counted.
lists.mergeNote: Lines with the same item, quality and mode count together: Buy lines add up, Top up lines use the largest target, and the strictest limits win.
lists.problem.notMarketable: Not sold on the market board
lists.problem.cap: Max per unit must be 0 to 999,999,999
lists.problem.duplicate: Counts together with another line for this item
lists.import.title: Import a list
lists.import.help: Paste plain text such as 3x Darksteel Ore, a CSV with the header ItemId,Name,Quality,Mode,Quantity,MaxUnitPrice,ExcessAllowance, or an Auto Shopper JSON export. Nothing changes until you choose what to do with the rows.
lists.import.problem.cap: Max per unit out of range
lists.import.problem.name: Name too long
lists.import.problem.unknown: No marketable item has this name or id
lists.import.error.empty: Paste a list above to see what it holds.
lists.import.error.tooLarge: The text is over the 256 KB limit.
lists.import.error.tooMany: More than 1,000 rows. Split the list and import it in parts.
lists.import.error.format: This JSON is not an Auto Shopper list.
lists.import.error.version: This list comes from a newer Auto Shopper. Update the plugin to import it.

lists.command.ambiguous: “{0}” matches several items: {1}. Add it by item id instead.

plan.partial.other: Partial estimate: {0} units are not covered and not in the total. See Not covered below.

plan.reason.stopLimit: The most stops setting cut it

plan.reason.notMarketable: Universalis does not list this item

shopping.tabSub: Spending limits, how plans are chosen, and the worlds a run may shop on.
shopping.spendCapHelp: The most one run may spend on purchases, fees included. There is no unlimited setting: Start refuses while no cap is set. The Plan page compares its estimate against this cap.
shopping.spendCapMissing: No spend cap is set yet. Runs will refuse to start until you set one; plans still work.
shopping.reserveHelp: Gil a run always leaves in your purse. A purchase that would take you below it is skipped.
shopping.modeHelp: How a plan trades the estimated total against the number of worlds it visits. The Plan page compares all three on the same prices.
shopping.mode.cheapest.name: Cheapest
shopping.mode.cheapest.detail: The lowest estimated total. An extra stop only loses a tie.
shopping.mode.balanced.name: Balanced
shopping.mode.balanced.detail: Weighs the total against the stop and data center penalties below.
shopping.mode.fewest.name: Fewest stops
shopping.mode.fewest.detail: The fewest worlds, costing at most the premium below over the cheapest plan.
shopping.stopPenaltyHelp: What one more world visit is worth to you in gil. Balanced adds it for every stop away from your world. It only steers the choice; nobody is charged.
shopping.crossPenaltyHelp: Added on top of the stop penalty for every data center change in Balanced. It only steers the choice; nobody is charged.
shopping.premiumHelp: How much more than the cheapest plan Fewest stops may cost, in percent.
shopping.maxStopsHelp: The most worlds one plan may visit. 0 means no limit.
shopping.staleAfterHelp: Prices uploaded longer ago than this are flagged as old on the Plan page. Get prices again before you trust them.
shopping.presetHelp: The worlds a plan may use before your own changes below.
shopping.preset.currentWorld.name: Current world
shopping.preset.currentWorld.detail: Only the world you are standing on.
shopping.preset.home.name: Home data center
shopping.preset.home.detail: Every world of your home data center.
shopping.preset.current.name: Current data center
shopping.preset.current.detail: Every world of the data center you are on.
shopping.preset.region.name: Whole region
shopping.preset.region.detail: Every world of your home region. Data center changes take longer and need travel.

shopping.logInForWorlds: Log in to see and pick the worlds.
shopping.noWorlds: No world is selected. Prices and plans need at least one.
shopping.japanNote: Japanese data centers: World Visit between them changed on 13 October 2026, and that route is untested. Unless the setting below allows Japanese data centers, Japanese worlds outside the data center you stand on stay out of prices, plans and runs.

route.setting.revisitsHelp: How many times one run may return to a world it already shopped, when the plan for what is left finds stock there. 0 never goes back.
route.picker.japanLeftOut: Left out while Japanese data centers are off
shop.reason.journal: look at the purchase journal on the Shop page
shop.reason.reconcile: say whether the uncertain purchase went through
shop.reason.interrupted: resume or discard the interrupted run
shop.reason.listLoading: wait for the item data to load
shop.reason.listErrors: fix the lines the list marks
shop.reason.noCap: set a run spend cap in Settings, Shopping
shop.reason.readingOff: wait for an update: the market board cannot be read on this game version
shop.reason.buyingOff: buying is off on this game version
shop.reason.busy: stop the task that is running
run.noIssues: Nothing has gone wrong so far.
lists.noSelectionBody: Pick a list on the left to edit it, or start a new one.
lists.import.craftingHelp: Crafting lists exported as JSON and lists copied from Teamcraft work too.
lists.import.sourceHelp: Detect reads the shape of the text. Pick the source yourself when detection guesses wrong.
lists.import.expansionHelp: A crafting list names what to craft, not what to buy. Choose how far down its recipes the shopping goes.
lists.import.expansion.finishedHelp: Buy what the list makes, ready made.
lists.import.expansion.directHelp: Buy what the list's crafts use; pre-crafts the list makes itself are not bought.
lists.import.expansion.fullHelp: Craft every ingredient that can be crafted and buy only what cannot.
lists.import.recipesFailed: Recipe data could not be loaded. The console has the details.
lists.import.problem.crafted: Made from other rows on this list
lists.import.problem.untradable: Untradable or not sold on the market board
lists.import.problem.recipe: Recipe not found in the game data
lists.import.error.craftingVersion: This crafting list was saved in a format this version cannot read. Export it again and paste the new copy.
lists.import.error.craftingFormat: This JSON is not a crafting list.
lists.import.summaryLeftOut: Ready {0}  ·  Pick one {1}  ·  Unknown {2}  ·  Invalid {3}  ·  Left out {4}
lists.import.layoutHelp: MakePlace and ReMakePlace layouts work too: every furnishing, fixture, wallpaper and dye in the house becomes a row.
lists.import.fileTitle: Open a list or layout file
lists.import.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read.
lists.import.error.layoutFormat: This JSON is not a MakePlace layout.
lists.crystals.help: Top up shards, crystals or clusters in one step.
lists.crystals.title: Add crystals
lists.crystals.body: Each pick becomes a Top up line at any quality, so a run buys only what your crystal bag is missing. A Top up line already on the list for that crystal takes the new target.
lists.crystals.targetHelp: How many of each picked crystal you want to own, 1 to 9,999 (the most the crystal bag holds).
lists.crystals.none: Pick at least one element and one kind.
lists.crystals.leftOut.one: {0} crystal was left out: the list is full or the item data does not know it.
lists.crystals.leftOut.other: {0} crystals were left out: the list is full or the item data does not know them.
plan.emptyList: This list has no lines yet. Add items on the Lists page to plan it.
export.summaryHelp: Items, worlds, quantities and gil of this run. Character names, content ids, retainers and listing ids are never in it.
export.summaryCopied: Run summary copied to the clipboard
export.summaryNotRecorded: This run was recorded before run summaries were kept.
export.summaryJournalGone: This run's purchase journal is gone, so its summary can no longer be made.
export.summaryReadFailed: The purchase journal could not be read. The console has the details.
export.checklistHelp: Copies this plan as a shopping checklist: stops, items, quantities and estimates. Nothing about your character.
lists.import.problem.ambiguous: Could be a decimal: use plain digits
plan.reason.capped: Capped: a world sent only its 100 cheapest listings, so more may be on the board
lists.problem.mergedOverLimit: This item's lines add up to more than 999,999
api.reason.schema: the request uses a Buying API schema this version of Auto Shopper does not know
api.reason.consent: allow {0} on Auto Shopper's Shop page first
api.reason.denied: {0} is denied; allow it in Auto Shopper's Settings, General
api.reason.quotesWaiting: this plugin already has {0} quotes waiting for their turn at the price fetch
api.consent.title: {0} wants to buy through Auto Shopper.
api.consent.body: It sends its own shopping list and a spend cap for each run. Your worlds, gil reserve and purchase checks still apply, and you can revoke this in Settings, General.
api.consent.facts: Internal name: {0}. This run asks to spend up to {1}. A plugin's runs keep to the cap they send, in place of your run spend cap.
api.groupNone: No plugin has asked to buy through Auto Shopper yet.
api.allowedHelp: It can price items and start runs through Auto Shopper. Revoke stops a run it has under way and makes it ask again.
api.deniedHelp: Its runs are refused until you allow it.
